common_public_record: On 18 December 2017, at meeting S/PV.8139, the Security Council considered Egypt's draft S/2017/1060 on Jerusalem, submitted on behalf of the Group of Arab States. The draft received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The sole negative vote came from the United States. The chair declared the draft unadopted because of the negative vote of a permanent member. The failed draft created no new Council obligations.
